wordle.title: Guess the tag
wordle.detailWon: found in {attempts, plural, one {# try} other {# tries}}, {hints, plural, =0 {no hints} one {# hint} other {# hints}}

items: Guess a CS pro's tag in 6 tries. Every guess must be a tag from the pool.
🟩 green = right character, right spot · 🟨 amber = present but misplaced · ⬛ grey = absent.
The tabs switch tag length: each length is its own independent board.
💡 A hint reveals one character of the answer (marked amber on the keyboard) and does not use up a try.
Some tags contain digits.

guessr.subtitle: One pro a day. Unlimited tries, clues on every guess.

items: 🎯 Find the mystery CS pro.
⌨️ Guess a tag from the pool: each guess fills a row comparing 7 attributes.
🟩 Green = exact match.
🟨 Amber = partial overlap (former teams / roles).
⬜ Grey = no overlap.
▲ = the target's value is higher, ▼ lower (age, majors, tournaments).
♾️ Unlimited tries.
💡 A hint reveals one column of the answer but counts as a try (max {maxHints}).

moreOrLessr.detail: {score, plural, one {# correct answer} other {# correct answers}} out of {total}

items: Pick a category: HLTV rating or career earnings.
Two players appear: the left value (the anchor) is visible, the challenger's is hidden.
Guess whether the challenger is HIGHER or LOWER than the anchor.
Right or wrong, the challenger becomes the next anchor and the chain continues.
All 10 rounds are played through — a wrong answer does not end the run.
Every correct answer scores, and a perfect 10 earns a bonus.
Giving up ends the run immediately, keeping the score earned so far.
